novelty_basis: The ETP paper (Bolan et al., arXiv:2512.07087, section 7.3.1) reports that Mace4 exhausts size 8 for equation 677 in 1.5 s. The lab adds an independently checkable certificate (DRAT proofs verified by drat-trim).
proof_check: computer-assisted - the CNFs of the case split of proofs/paper/C05.md Lemma 8 (written proof), with the implied division clauses of Lemma 9 (written) and Latin rows (Lean: law677_left_bijective), are all UNSAT, each refuted by a DRAT proof from CaDiCaL 1.5.3 that drat-trim verified (45 CNFs; EXP-C05-08); the controls at n = 5, 6, 7 agree with EXP-C05-03; awaiting independent review (Skeptic, batch 1.1)
statement: No magma of order 8 satisfies x = y(x((yx)y)) (ETP equation 677).
title: Law 677, x = y(x((yx)y)), has no model of order 8 (rediscovery; DRAT-certified)
